Card Q&A.q: When this card is played without paying the cost, can I use its 1st effect to trash a specified card from my hand?

a: You choose 1 of your opponent's Digimon, then choose its digivolution cards to be trashed by this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect.

a: If you don't place 1 Digimon card from your trash face down as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, the part of this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect after "then" can't return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck.
